counts.counts_basis: Recomputed by Judge T013 from the rows and applied by Worker T015 on 2026-07-26. Arithmetic: 11 retrievable + 17 gated + 6 none = 34 scored; 34 scored + 4 unverified + 1 invalid = 39 total. Strong attestation means single_document_full_scope or deferral_two_part; weak means scope_by_exclusion. Excluding the one instrument_inferred row, bm_0058, the strong subset is 8 rows, 5 documents and 3 issuers.

row_class_definitions.retrievable: A public document was fetched this session at HTTP 200 without a login, it contains CPT 27447, its sha256 is recorded, and a verbatim quote attests that it governs this payer, plan type and state.
row_class_definitions.gated: The controlling document exists but requires a login, a portal credential, an NPI, or a payer telephone call. Scored as an adjudicated-abstention test.
row_class_definitions.none: The payer publishes no policy for this line of business. Scored as an adjudicated-abstention test.
row_class_definitions.invalid: The row itself is not answerable because the plan or product does not exist for this payer and line of business. Excluded from the scored denominator, never deleted.
row_class_definitions.unverified: Public evidence was pursued in good faith and could not settle the label. Excluded from the scored denominator. Never guessed.

attestation_basis_definitions.single_document_full_scope: One fetched document names the payer, the plan type and the state, and lists CPT 27447. Strongest.
attestation_basis_definitions.deferral_two_part: Part one is a payer page stating in writing that this plan type follows CMS NCDs and LCDs. Part two is the CMS LCD or article whose own contractor table lists this row's state, and whose companion Billing and Coding Article lists CPT 27447. Strong.
attestation_basis_definitions.scope_by_exclusion: The document states which lines of business it does NOT cover, and this row's plan type falls in the remainder. It never names this plan type positively. WEAK. Report retrievable counts with and without these rows.
attestation_basis_definitions.negative_attestation: The document states in writing that it does not govern this row, which is what makes the row invalid.
attestation_basis_definitions.ambiguous: The document contains conflicting scope markings for this plan type.
attestation_basis_definitions.none_found: No document attesting applicability was found.
attestation_basis_definitions.not_applicable: Row is gated or none; no attestation is expected.

cms_note: CPT 27447 does NOT appear on any CMS LCD page. CMS places procedure codes in a separate companion Billing and Coding Article. All four LCDs used here were confirmed to contain zero occurrences of 27447, and all four companion articles were confirmed to contain it. Both URLs are recorded on every Medicare Advantage row, and cpt_27447_present is measured against the companion article. A retrieval answer naming only the LCD must not be graded wrong for this reason alone.

known_limitations: The retrievable side collapses to 7 unique documents across 11 rows, so these are not independent draws.
Two retrievable rows (bm_0073, bm_0084) rest on scope_by_exclusion, the weakest basis. Report the retrievable count both with and without them.

Four rows are unverified (bm_0068, bm_0079, bm_0086, bm_0089) and one is invalid (bm_0063). bm_0058 was promoted from unverified to retrievable by Judge T013 under rubric section 2.2, on a document T003 never reached, so it is no longer carried in this list. Four of the spec's thirteen public rows did not survive as retrievable: bm_0063 (invalid), and bm_0068, bm_0079 and bm_0089 (unverified). The fourth unverified row, bm_0086, was login_gated in the spec and never a public row, so the earlier count of six public non-survivors was one too high even before the bm_0058 promotion. The CareFirst pin to Maryland IS load-bearing: Maryland and DC are Novitas J-L (L36007) but Virginia is Palmetto J-M (L33456). If Andrew pins CareFirst to Virginia, bm_0059's LCD changes.

ma_deferral_status uses a fourth value, 'unverified', on rows where no payer document attests deferral. The task specified three values; the fourth was added rather than assert a status without evidence.

One retrievable row, bm_0058, has plan_type_named 'instrument_inferred' rather than 'explicit'. The Blue Shield of California utilization management page never writes 'Medicare Advantage'. Its plan type is identified only by the instrument it names, the Medicare Managed Care Manual (CMS Pub. 100-16), which binds Medicare Advantage organizations only. The strong-attestation subset must therefore be reported both ways: 9 rows / 6 documents / 3 issuers including bm_0058, and 8 rows / 5 documents / 3 issuers excluding it.

Five of the eleven retrievable rows (bm_0056, bm_0057, bm_0058, bm_0059, bm_0061) rest on a page whose recorded content hash does not reproduce, so on those rows the sha256 is not an identity check. Task T016 refetched every recorded hash on 2026-07-26. The three CMS Medicare Coverage Database article pages (A59811, A56777, A56796) return a fresh per-request ASP.NET anti-forgery token, so every fetch yields a different raw sha256; on each page, eight fetches whose digest was recorded produced eight distinct values. The Blue Shield of California utilization management page has produced three distinct digests across three sessions. The BCBSM and CareFirst attestation pages recorded in ma_convention.plan_page are unstable for the same kind of reason, a build timestamp in an HTML comment and a monitoring-agent parameter; they belong to rows already counted here, so the row count stays five. On all of those pages the change is confined to a non-semantic token, the verbatim attestation text and CPT 27447 were re-confirmed present, and no document content changed. Identity on these rows rests on identity_string, on content_hash_normalized where recorded, and on the verbatim attestation_quote, never on the raw digest. The Horizon page recorded on bm_0061 is a separate and more serious case; see the next item.

OPEN AND UNRESOLVED. On bm_0061 the Horizon attestation page (ma_convention.plan_page) served two different content variants during the T016 sweep on 2026-07-26. Two responses at about 16:45 UTC carried the recorded verbatim quote, which is part one of that row's deferral_two_part basis. Nineteen responses over the following twenty minutes did not carry it at all, including under a cookie-bearing session, under no-cache request headers and across three URL spellings, all at HTTP 200 with no login wall. T016 did not retain the earlier bytes, so it cannot distinguish a page edit from edge-node content variants. Until a Judge rules, treat bm_0061's part-one attestation as observed once and not reliably re-retrievable. T016 did not change the row_class, because a Worker may not.

open_human_decision.question: When a Medicare Advantage plan genuinely defers to Medicare, does a real appeal cite the Medicare regional rule (the LCD and its billing article) or the plan's own page stating that it follows Medicare?
open_human_decision.how_this_key_handles_it: Every Medicare Advantage row records both candidate answers in ma_convention. The ruling is applied by switching the graded column, with no research redone.
